verse.verse_1: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High.
verse.verse_2: Who has created, and then proportioned it.
verse.verse_3: And Who has measured; and then guided.
verse.verse_4: And Who brings out the pasturage,
verse.verse_5: And then makes it dark stubble.
verse.verse_6: We shall make you recite, so you shall not forget,
verse.verse_7: Except what Allah may will He knows what is apparent and what is hidden.
verse.verse_8: And We shall make easy for you the easy.
verse.verse_9: Therefore remind in case the reminder profits.
verse.verse_10: The reminder will be received by him who fears,
verse.verse_11: But it will be avoided by the wretched,
verse.verse_12: Who will enter the great Fire.
verse.verse_13: There he will neither die nor live.
verse.verse_14: Indeed whosoever purifies himself shall achieve success.
verse.verse_15: And remembers the Name of his Lord, and performs Salah.
verse.verse_16: Rather you prefer the life of this world.
verse.verse_17: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
verse.verse_18: Verily, this is in the former Scriptures
verse.verse_19: The Scriptures of Ibrahim and Musa.
